Free CV and Resume Templates: Build a Professional Resume Fast

How to build an ATS-friendly resume in your browser in minutes with TemplateBox's free CV templates. No sign-up, no watermark, instant PDF download.

A strong resume should not require expensive software or a design degree. TemplateBox gives you professionally structured CV templates that you personalize directly in your browser and download as a real, selectable-text PDF. No account, no watermark, and nothing you type ever leaves your device.

Why ATS-friendly formatting matters

Most mid-size and large employers run resumes through an Applicant Tracking System before a human sees them. Resumes exported as images or scanned documents often fail this step because the software cannot read the text. Every TemplateBox resume exports with true vector text, so parsing systems read your name, roles, and skills exactly as you wrote them.

Three layouts, one workflow

  • Executive Resume - a commanding serif-led layout for senior roles.
  • Modern Professional CV - clean accent-colored sections with a live preview.
  • Minimalist ATS Resume - a distraction-free single-column format tuned for tracking systems.

Each template uses the same split-pane editor: type on the left, watch the finished document update live on the right, then download. Your progress saves automatically in your browser, so you can close the tab and pick up where you left off.

Build yours now

Open the template catalog, pick a resume layout, and you can have a polished, ATS-safe PDF in under ten minutes.
